Shah Rukh Khan provides update on upcoming film 'King'

Actor Shah Rukh Khan has provided an update on his upcoming film, 'King', stating that injuries had delayed its shooting schedule but that the film is "nearly all done." He indicated that the film is on track for a December release. Khan also teased a "whistle-worthy" dialogue from the gangster film, referencing the line "King Akela Kaafi Hai." He described the film's progress by saying, "We're the centre's tasty tikki."
